test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been listed, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option 1: TALE**N **has the word N in it but not R. So, it is not a combination of the letters of the word LATER.

Option 2: ATLER is a combination of the word LATER. 

Option 3: TALER is a combination of the word LATER. 

Option 4: LATER is a combination of the word LATER. 

So, from the given options, TALEN is the odd one among them.

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 1"**.
